title: Settings
generalIntro: Make this workspace feel like yours.
languageHint: Interface language. Your research content stays unchanged.
defaultHint: Used for new conversations; existing conversations keep their connection.
darkHint: A quiet, dark workspace for focused research.
privacyIntro: Know what stays here, what leaves, and what can run.
credentialSafety: API keys and OAuth tokens stay in the operating system keychain, not in the browser or research database.
networkBoundary: Your selected provider receives the prompts and project content used in a request. Local-first does not mean offline.
executionBoundary: The agent can edit files and execute commands with your local permissions. This is not an operating system sandbox.
billingBoundary: A subscription connection never silently falls back to a paid API key. Limits and eligibility are controlled by the provider.
connectionsIntro: Choose a provider, then connect with your account or API key.
catalogHint: Account and key options live under each provider.
empty: Connect your first account to start researching.
modelPlaceholder: Choose or enter a model ID
metadataHint: Capabilities come from the provider SDK or your configuration. Availability depends on the account; the chat UI currently sends text and tool results.
saveBeforeRefresh: Save this connection before refreshing models.
subscriptionHint: Sign in in your browser to authorize eligible subscription usage. No Platform API key is required; the provider controls shared limits and access.
planHint: Authenticate with the API key issued for this plan. Use its matching endpoint and region to draw from plan allowances.
localHint: Connect to a model server running on your computer. The server must already be running.
apiHint: Usage is billed by this provider's API account. A consumer chat subscription does not automatically include API credits.
interactiveOnly: This connection is reserved for interactive research. Scheduled unattended runs are disabled.
name: Connection name
keyStored: Stored securely. Leave blank to keep it.
testHint: Tests use the saved configuration and consume a small amount of provider quota.
localSignOut: Signed out locally. Remote revocation was not confirmed; disconnect the app in the provider's settings.
oauthHint: Your password is entered only on the provider's website. This app never reads another tool's login files.
signedIn: Signed in. Select a model to continue.
methodHint: Use the sign-in method supported by your provider. API keys can use plan allowances or metered billing; choose the matching plan and region.
keySignIn: Sign in with an API key
